expectedVersions.note: claude plugin CLI has no ref-pinning flag, so these are the versions resolved at last known-good install. apply.ps1 warns (does not block) if a fresh install lands on a different version.

pluginConfigs.note: jev-skill-suggestion 'inject' MUST stay 'suggest', never 'content'. Code review (2026-09-23) found 'content' injects the picked skill's SKILL.md body directly into the prompt with a 'follow this now' instruction, bypassing the normal Skill-tool gate (skillOverrides, permission checks). It also draws candidates from the current working directory's .claude/skills, so a cloned repo could plant a SKILL.md that gets auto-injected. 'suggest' only names the skill; the real Skill tool loads it with normal checks. Never run /jev-skill-suggestion:setup (hides the skill listing entirely, making the model depend solely on this plugin). Never set typesafeApiKey/gatewayApiKey (that's what sends prompt text externally).

statusLine.note: caveman-statusline.ps1 path is version-pinned (e.g. .../caveman/caveman/2.7.0/src/hooks/...). apply.ps1 resolves the actual installed version on each machine instead of hardcoding it.
